_comment: CRT XAUUSD 4H+15M research. PRE-REGISTERED v2 (immediate engulfing confirmation; FVG/IFVG removed by owner before any evaluation). Do not edit parameters after observing results; any change must bump preregistration_version and be logged in docs/PREREGISTRATION.md.

data._metadata_fields: source, broker, format (generic|mt5), timestamp_tz (IANA name or 'NY+7' for MT4/MT5 GMT+2/+3 servers), timestamp_convention (bar_open), price_side (bid|mid|ask), volume_type (tick|real|unknown), spread_units_per_price (e.g. 100 for MT5 points on XAUUSD)

sweep._long: Low_15M < Low_ref4H (strict). Only the FIRST penetrating bar of the execution 4H counts.
sweep._short: High_15M > High_ref4H (strict). Only the FIRST penetrating bar of the execution 4H counts.
sweep.stop_anchor: extreme of sweep bar and confirmation bar (both closed before entry)

confirmation._long: Close_s < Open_s ; Close_c > Open_c ; Open_c <= Close_s ; Close_c >= Open_s
confirmation._short: Close_s > Open_s ; Close_c < Open_c ; Open_c >= Close_s ; Close_c <= Open_s

volume._base: volume_c >= 1.5 * mean(volume of the 20 previous 15M bars); current bar excluded

costs._status: ASSUMED PLACEHOLDERS - replace with the broker's real XAUUSD spread/commission before interpreting results. Units: USD per ounce of price (1.00 = 100 MT5 points on 2-digit XAUUSD).

display_cell._comment: Only BASE exists as hypothesis; charts drawn for BASE, group LONDON+NY plus per-KZ comparisons.

instrument._comment: v2.1.0: data source = Databento CME GC futures (no spot XAUUSD with volume reachable). Registered before any data was seen.
instrument.roll_rule: setup skipped if ref or exec 4H spans >1 contract or they differ; trade skipped if contract changes between confirmation and exit
instrument.costs_note: cost placeholders kept unchanged from v2.0.0 (spread 0.20 = 2 GC ticks, commission 0.07/oz = $7/contract RT, slippage 0.05/side)
